Oaza Electronics 与我们的团队密切合作，帮助促进了计算机化培训系统的开发。
A. hardly
B. nearly
C. closely
D. relatively

items.question: Oaza Electronics worked ------- with our team she to facilitate the development of the computerized training system.
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：将“closely”代入题干后为“Oaza Electronics worked closely with our team she to facilitate the development of the computerized training system.”。选择理由：该项的词性或动词形态符合句法位置，同时与上下文语义搭配自然。正确答案：C（closely）。
